a:r.a:t: Six implemented capabilities form one connected fan experience
Register, sign in, restore the current user, and reach protected routes with a bearer token.
Browse one selected local date with status groups, local kickoff times, ordering, and pagination.
Review overview, statistics, lineups, timeline, and an explicit Chat coming-soon boundary.
Search publicly, open a useful team profile, view match outlook, and return through recent searches.
Follow, list, and remove teams through authenticated user-scoped operations.
Review persisted summaries, unread counts, read state, mark-all-read, and stored global preferences.
Every capability on this page is executable in the current release; later features begin in the dedicated roadmap section.
